thread:
alerts-bot: INCIDENT alert - gpu-queue-high in prod-east1 (sev2). queue length rising, token-throttles engaging. auto-escalate to on-call. https://ops.redwood/status/INC-4821 :rotating_light:

alerts-bot: metrics snapshot: queue=820, 5m qps=1200, throttled_requests=47%. autoscaler reported max_nodes=80 for pool gpu-pool-east1.

sara (oncall): seeing failed jobs in the UI, customers reporting slow responses. good morning, i'm on it. anyone on-call for autoscaler config? @matt?

matt (eng-runtime): i can help. curious if this is just a cold surge or autoscaler stuck at configured ceiling. pinging ops for manual cap lift if needed. what is current pending pod count?

lina (ops): pending pods ~210, running gpus at 80/80. autoscaler logs show "max node limit reached" and "scale down disabled until manual override".

oliver (sre): impact: several enterprise routes timing out (customer-facing low-rate pricing). Triage: sev2 because partial customer impact and degraded SLAs.

sara (oncall): ok plan: 1) request manual max-nodes bump to 120, 2) enable temporary permissive-scaling flag, 3) watch queues. need operator approval and ops-run. matt can you draft the exact command?

matt (eng-runtime): propose running our internal control-plane tool. command:

```bash
rcp autoscaler update --pool gpu-pool-east1 --set max_nodes=120 --reason "prod surge 1728601234 - manual override by oncall"
```

matt (eng-runtime): also recommend toggling safety_stop to false for 15m: `rcp autoscaler update --pool gpu-pool-east1 --set safety_stop=false --ttl 15m`

lina (ops): i need approval from ops lead for permanent changes. for emergency manual bump i can run once i get +1 from eng and SRE. tagging @ops-bot to log the action.

ops-bot: OPS ACTION REQUIRED - Please supply operator id and confirmation. Log ticket created: OPS-7854.

oliver (sre): +1 from SRE for a temporary bump to 120 and safety_stop=false for 20m. we'll keep autoscaler watch and rollback after queue < 50 for two consecutive minutes.

sara (oncall): +1 from oncall. @lina you have authorization to proceed with the one-off bump. please include the operator id and ETA.

lina (ops): running the bump now. operator id=linops. executing:

```bash
# dry-run first
rcp autoscaler update --pool gpu-pool-east1 --set max_nodes=120 --dry-run
# apply
rcp autoscaler update --pool gpu-pool-east1 --set max_nodes=120 --reason "emergency bump - queue surge"
rcp autoscaler update --pool gpu-pool-east1 --set safety_stop=false --ttl 20m
```

lina (ops): applied. API responded: {"status":"accepted","job_id":"ops-1728601234-1"}

alerts-bot: EVENT - autoscaler config change applied by linops (operator). job ops-1728601234-1.

matt (eng-runtime): seeing new nodes provisioning. node join logs: 
```
[1728601301] node-gpu-81 joined pool
[1728601355] node-gpu-82 joined pool
[1728601420] node-gpu-83 joined pool
```

oliver (sre): queue trending down: 820 -> 430 in last 8 minutes. throttled_requests down to 12%. routing fallback applied for high-latency customers.

sara (oncall): FYI customers notified via status page and support: messaging says degraded performance with mitigation in progress. link: https://status.redwood/down/INC-4821

matt (eng-runtime): watch for pod scheduling failures; if kube rejects pods due to per-node pod limits we may need to adjust kubelet `maxPods` or pack fewer gpus per node. current plan keeps defaults.

lina (ops): also noted cluster autoscaler logs show a stale annotation interfering with scale-up. i've cleared the annotation `autoscaler.block=true` on pool config.

ops-bot: OPS LOG - cleared annotation autoscaler.block=true by linops. ticket OPS-7854 updated.

oliver (sre): good catch. after node joins, pending pods draining quickly. queue now at 180. throttling at 3%. customer impact decreasing.

sara (oncall): timeline: 08:00 alert, 08:06 manual bump requested, 08:12 bump applied, 08:20 nodes joined, 08:30 queue under control. we'll hold the change for 20m then rollback to prior max_nodes=80 once stable.

matt (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) investigate autoscaler config drift that set low ceiling, 2) add automated alert when queue > 500 for >5m, 3) test fallback model variants for low-cost routing. I'll open ENGRT-1059.

lina (ops): rolling back safety_stop to true at 08:36 as TTL expired. keeping max_nodes=120 for now until postmortem.

alerts-bot: INCIDENT update - mitigation successful, queue stabilized. monitoring continues.

oliver (sre): moving to post-incident review. tagging stakeholders. please upload any logs or commands used to OPS-7854.

sara (oncall): great work team. I'll coordinate the postmortem and customer outreach notes. closing slack thread as real-time triage ends. :white_check_mark:
